author: Tamás Pál
name: Rask Native Mobile App (iOS + Android)
description: A native iOS/Android app that hosts a Rask app inside a platform WebView (WebView hybrid). Native + Local runs the component code in-process on the device; Native + Server is a thin native shell over a remote Rask Server with native device capabilities bridged to the page.

choices.description: Native + Local — the Rask component code runs in-process on the device (offline, store-distributable).
Native + Server — a thin native shell over a remote Rask Server; the head bridges native device capabilities (e.g. the OS share sheet) to the loaded page.

host.description: Which Rask.Native host mode to scaffold.
